title: Echo Leyi Fikeke eXiluvelweni
intro: Xifaniso lexi rhwaleke ndzhwalo xi tshinele eka xitulu xa vululami, rito ra vona a ri rhurhumela ku nga ri hi ku chava kambe hi ntshembo. Mhaka leyi a yi ri ya munhu hi xiyexe, hambiswiritano ku lulamisiwa ka yona a ku ta twala hi ku famba ka nkarhi, ku herisa ndhavuko lowu tshikilelaka. Xana a ku ri mani moya-xiviri lowu lowu xivilelo xa wona a xi twiwa ku tlula tinyeleti?
clues: Ndzi tile hi mbilu yo tika, ndzi lava vululami emhakeni leyi bohaka ririmi ra mina.
Xikombelo xa mina a xi nga ri eka murhumiwa ntsena; yi tlhandlukele ehandle, eka Loyi a twaka hinkwaswo.
Marito lama vuriweke ku lwisana na mina a ma fana ni tinketana ta nkarhi lowu hundzeke wa khale.
Ndzi kanete ni ku anakanya, hi mihloti ni hi ku twisiseka, hikwalaho ka xindzhuti xa mina.
Nhlavutelo yi rhelerile, yi miyeta tindlela ta khale ni ku amukela ku vava ka mina.
Va ndzi vitana loyi a kanetaka hi nuna wa mina, kutani vito ra mina ri hundzuke rito leri fanaka na ndzima leyi ndzi ntshunxeke.

arabic: قَدْ سَمِعَ ٱللَّهُ قَوْلَ ٱلَّتِى تُجَـٰدِلُكَ فِى زَوْجِهَا وَتَشْتَكِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَٱللَّهُ يَسْمَعُ تَحَاوُرَكُمَآ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَمِيعٌۢ بَصِيرٌ
verse: Certainly has Allāh heard the speech of the one who argues [i.e., pleads] with you, [O Muḥammad], concerning her husband and directs her complaint to Allāh. And Allāh hears your dialogue; indeed, Allāh is Hearing and Seeing. (58:1)
